newsitem.title: USA: Microware sees loss for Q4, FY97.
newsitem.headline: Microware sees loss for Q4, FY97.

text.p: Microware Systems Corp said Monday it expects to report a net loss for the fourth quarter and fiscal year ended March 31.
The company said it expects revenues for the quarter to be about $6 million and for the year to be about $26 million.
The software company reported revenue of $6.8 million and net income of $481,000 in the year-ago quarter and revenue of $23.7 million and net income of $1.4 million in fiscal 1996.

The shortfall in anticipated revenue was due to the unexpected delay of key customer product shipments to future quarters, Microware said. The quarter was also adversely affected by an increase in spending on the development and marketing of the company's products for emerging consumer products markets and by adverse foreign currency fluctuations, Microware said.
The company's year-end results will also include a one-time charge related to the restructuring of certain European operations, Microware said.

"We are disappointed that the fourth quarter did not come in as strongly as we had anticipated," president Ken Kaplan said in a news release. "However, we are encouraged by the significant new design wins we achieved during the quarter, and continue to foresee significant growth in revenue over the next year as major customers such as Motorola, Uniden, IBM, Ericsson, and General Instrument begin to bring their new OS-9-based smart products to market."
